name: Papaverine
description: Alkaloid obtained from opium or made synthetically; relaxes smooth muscle directly

status.usStatus: Not FDA approved; sold as unapproved Rx

note.text: The injection label says it is not indicated for impotence, and that penile injection has caused persistent priapism.

bullets: **Relaxes smooth muscle directly,** especially in large arteries (label)
Acts on **blood vessels** and the gut, bile and urinary tracts
**Minimal effects on the brain,** per the label

practical.halfLife: Not established; label says estimates vary widely
practical.pharmacokinetics: Liver metabolism; about 90% bound to blood proteins
practical.soldAs: Unapproved Rx injection; compounded Bimix and Trimix

regulatory.text: Not approved; marketed as an unapproved drug
Label: not for injection into the penis

references: American Regent, papaverine injection label (DailyMed), Jul 2026
Bechara et al., J Urol, papaverine-phentolamine vs alprostadil, Jun 1997
Seyam et al., Int J Impot Res, Trimix vs alprostadil, Jul 2005
